account.title: Account
account.deleteWarn: This permanently removes your personal data — name, email, phone, location, wishlist. You will be signed out immediately.
account.deleteKeeps: Anonymised order records are kept for the period tax and consumer law require, then purged.
consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: Product 31 needs your agreement to a few things. Required items are marked *.
consent.tosPre: I have read and accept the
consent.dataUse: I agree that my phone number and order details are used to run my account and pickup orders.
consent.location: Use my location to show nearby shops
consent.withdraw: You can change the optional choices any time in Account settings.

shop.closedBanner: This shop is closed right now — you can still look around.

voice.title: Order by voice
voice.noVoiceForLang: This device has no Tamil voice — replies stay text-only.
voice.hintEn: Say what you want — e.g. "two milk, one rice, half kg dal".
voice.hintTa: என்ன வேணும்னு சொல்லுங்க — எ.கா. "ரெண்டு ஆவின் பால்".
voice.noSpeech: Didn't catch that — try again or type it.
voice.micError: Microphone unavailable — type your order instead.
voice.unsupported: Voice isn't available on this device — type your order.
voice.micDenied: Microphone access is off. Turn it on in Settings to order by voice, or just type your order.
voice.micDismissed: No problem — tap the mic when you're ready, or type your order.
voice.privacyNote: Your speech is turned into text by your phone's voice service (Google on Android, Apple on iPhone). We keep only the text of your order.
cart.title: Your order
cart.codNote: You pay cash when you collect. The shop confirms first.
cart.placedSub: Show this code at the counter:
cart.placedHint: The shop will accept it shortly — watch for the update.
shop.priceRangeNote: This shop shows price ranges. The exact total is confirmed at pickup.
shop.priceHiddenNote: This shop doesn't list prices online — you pay at the counter.

sk.qrSoon: Your shop QR code + printable poster comes in build step 7.
